description: This bar chart illustrates the GLUE performance for different fine-tuning methods using RoBERTa models of varying sizes. The horizontal axis represents the fine-tuning method, labeled as “Prefix”, “Adaptor”, “LoRA”, “BitFit”, “S₁-model”, “S₂-model”, and “S₃-model”, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “GLUE Performance”, displays a linear scale ranging from 84 to 90, with tick marks at intervals of 2. For each fine-tuning method, there are two bars representing the model size: “base”, shown in blue, and “large”, shown in orange. The “base” model bars have approximate heights of 85, 87, 89, 86, 88, 89, and 89 for “Prefix”, “Adaptor”, “LoRA”, “BitFit”, “S₁-model”, “S₂-model”, and “S₃-model” respectively. The “large” model bars have approximate heights of 87, 89, 90, 88, 89, 90, and 90 for “Prefix”, “Adaptor”, “LoRA”, “BitFit”, “S₁-model”, “S₂-model”, and “S₃-model” respectively. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each fine-tuning method, with the “base” model bar always appearing to the left of the “large” model bar. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
